cuts.method: cuts2.py adaptive detector (ratio 3.0, abs 0.25); black flashes folded by stats2.py; spot-checked by eye on verify pairs + sheet

manual_corrections: Trimmed to 107.6 s (end screen). All 85 detected cuts confirmed by eye on verify pairs; added 3 soft cuts (18.4 maze-N to flat N, 83.2 fade-up of the pink card, 104.7 date card into N transition). Beatsync after correction: 14 % of cuts on onsets vs 12 % chance.

manual.trim_reason: 107.6-120.85 s is the YouTube end screen (N + SUBSCRIBE)
manual.letterbox: 2.00:1 inside 16:9 (active ~854x427, bars ~27 px = 5.5% H); cards and end logo also letterboxed
manual.subtitles: burned-in English subtitles for Korean dialogue and sung lyrics (with note symbols): white italic sans with soft shadow, ~4% H, centred, baseline ~88-90% H; 37 of 108 one-per-second samples (34%) carry a subtitle, most in 0-30 s (18 of 30)

corner_bug.0-4.4 s: top-left red vertical rule + 'SQUID GAME: / SEASON 3' white sans, cap ~2.1% H at x5-16%, y10-15%; top-right grey N monogram ~7.5% H

n_sting.where: after the 16.6 s cold open (sung 'Knock knock / who is there' + 'The game will begin momentarily')

maze dissolves into pink light bars that form the red N (105.1-105.7), N held on black to 107.3, fade out; audio bump 105.25 s (-30 -> -15 dBFS), likely the ta-dum (guess)

text_cards.style: white wide geometric show-font caps, distressed, on hot-pink grunge texture; starts ~1.4x oversize and settles to 1.0 in ~0.4 s, keeps drifting smaller (settle timed on an 8 fps strip, +-0.13 s)
same; between cards: 0.5-0.6 s shots with the countdown dialogue 'One.' 'Two.' 'Three.'
same pink card, fades up from a 0.4 s dip to black
circle/triangle/square on pink morph into the logo by ~98.4 s, held ~3.8 s
white sans (bold date, light eyebrow) over a rotating aerial of the stair-maze set
